_note: What "salary" includes, as the total of the SALARIES head (D-091): which components are salary is the registry's (each component's head, D-089); this row is the statute that makes it so, cited by gross salary. 2025 Act s.16 (pp.37–38): "For the purposes of this Part, 'salary' includes— (a) wages; (b) any annuity or pension; (c) any gratuity; (d) any fees or commission; (e) perquisites; (f) profits in lieu of, or in addition to, any salary or wages; (g) any advance of salary; (h) any payment received by an employee in respect of any period of leave not availed of by him; (i) … recognised provident fund …; (j) … transferred balance …; (k) the contribution made by the Central Government or any other employer … under a pension scheme referred to in section 124; and (l) the contribution made by the Central Government … to the Agniveer Corpus Fund …". TY 2025-26 (AY 2026-27): 1961 s.17(1) "'salary' includes— (i) wages; (ii) any annuity or pension; (iii) any gratuity; (iv) any fees, commissions, perquisites or profits in lieu of or in addition to any salary or wages; (v) any advance of salary; (va) leave not availed of; (vi), (vii) recognised provident fund; (viii) pension-scheme contribution" as on thc.nic.in (current to Act 7 of 2019), and clause (ix), the Agniveer Corpus Fund contribution, inserted by FA 2023 s.10(i). Not searched: any other clause-level amendment to s.17(1) between Act 7 of 2019 and AY 2026-27 besides FA 2023's — the inclusion list does not change what this row computes (the SALARIES head), only its wording.
